name: trauma
source:
Welcome home. A waste of endless time. 

You like serenity, sincerity and an endless fun? 

My little smol world is for you then!

[From [url=https://cokyfish.itch.io/trauma]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
歡迎回家。在這裡，消磨無窮無盡的時光。

你喜歡寧靜、真誠和永不落幕的歡樂嗎？

那麼，我這個小小小世界就是為你準備的！

[摘自[url=https://cokyfish.itch.io/trauma]Itch.io[/url]]
